curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the license chart letter by letter, then separate the look-alike class and endorsement letters.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per class or endorsement, with the H and P double meanings drilled as contrasts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Match each vehicle or credential to its class or endorsement letter.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who must hold a Tennessee license, what Class D covers, and when drivers need the For-Hire endorsement.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the weight limit, the Class C exceptions, Class D requirements and For-Hire rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on whether a driver needs Class D, Class C or the For-Hire endorsement.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Trace the Class PD permit from first test to Class D, then the rare Class H hardship path and its limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on PD ages and companions, the move to Class D, and hardship license limits and expiry.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on permit and hardship license ages, companions, limits and expiry.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate the people who need no Tennessee license from those who cannot get one, then cover the penalties for driving without a valid license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards contrasting exempt drivers with ineligible applicants, plus the two misdemeanors.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on exemptions, refusals and license penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Compare the identification-only licenses, then the temporary credentials tied to legal presence.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each identification license and on the TDL and TID codes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on which identification or temporary credential fits each applicant.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the optional license designations, voter registration, offender duties and the International Driving Permit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on donor and veteran designations, voter cards, offender duties and the IDP.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on designations, voter registration and international permits.
